Hi Carmen — great to hear. Thanks for starting this. Below is the standard intake we use for vendor activation (short, so procurement can move quickly):

What we need from you (external items):
- Completed vendor intake form (attached): redwood_procurement-intake_form.pdf
- W-9 or local tax equivalent (you noted you have this)
- Bank details for ACH / wire (account name, routing, SWIFT if international)
- Certificate of insurance (if services will be delivered onsite or under an SOW)
- Primary billing contact name, email, and phone
- Expected PO value and start date so we can pre-create a PO placeholder

What we provide / expect from Redwood:
- Preferred invoice format: PDF with PO number in subject and header; line-item pricing is optional but helpful
- Invoice cadence: Net 30 by default; Net 45 can be considered with account approval
- Remittance address: billing@redwood.ai (see Lauren’s note below for postal remittance)
- PO numbering: Please include the PO as: RDW-<YYYY>-<6-digit> (we’ll confirm exact number once procurement issues it)
- Purchase order and master terms are routed via DocuSign (link included when ready)

Next steps:
1) Fill and return redwood_procurement-intake_form.pdf and attach your W-9 + bank details.
2) Lauren (cc’d) will confirm remit address and any vendor-specific billing instructions.
3) We’ll generate a placeholder PO and send DocuSign for signature if standard terms are acceptable.

Attaching our vendor terms summary for quick review: redwood-vendor-terms-summary.docx

If you want a short call to walk through the intake, I’m free tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Thanks,
